item.title: Election 2026 live results: Dems take back Congress, Trump 'little bit surprised'
item.description: Collins is the five-term senator from Maine.

item.title: WATCH: Vivek Ramaswamy addresses supporters after projected defeat in Ohio governor's race
item.description: Republican Vivek Ramaswamy addressed supporters after ABC News projected Democrat Amy Acton will win the Ohio governor's race.

item.title: WATCH: House Speaker Mike Johnson speaks after Democrats projected to take control of House
item.description: House Speaker Mike Johnson made remarks after ABC News projected Democrats will win enough seats to take control of the House.

item.title: Champions League: Paris Saint-Germain make easy work of Villarreal
item.description: Paris Saint-Germain made easy work of Villarreal in the Champions League (6-0). The game was decided after 17 minutes and four goals.

item.title: DR Congo residents sue Chinese mining giant for widespread pollution
item.description: In Kolwezi, the mining capital of the Democratic Republic of Congo, local residents are suing a huge Chinese mine and the government for environmental pollution. It will be one of the most important cases the country has seen. FRANCE 24's correspondent Emmet Livingstone reports.

item.title: 30 million South Africans registered to vote across nine provinces
item.description: In South Africa, around 30 million people have registered to cast their votes across the country's nine provinces. The economy is at the forefront of the November 4 local elections. The spotlight is on Gauteng, a province long plagued by governance challenges. FRANCE 24's correspondent Eunice Masson reports.

item.title: Sudanese Arab refugees face hostility and distrust after fleeing to Chad
item.description: Thousands of Arab Sudanese who have arrived in Chad after fleeing fighting at home are facing mistrust and hostility from fellow Sudanese refugees. Fighters linked to the Rapid Support Forces, whose ranks are largely drawn from Sudan’s Arab communities, have been accused of repeatedly targeting civilians from other ethnic groups. FRANCE 24's Harold Girard reports.

item.title: Washington excludes South Africa and Rwanda from US duty-free trade deal
item.description: South African and Rwandan exporters are weighing potential job losses and squeezed margins after Washington decided to exclude them from the AGOA program, the African Growth and Opportunity Act, ending the countries' duty-free access to the US market. Economists warned against "alarmist" reactions to the exclusion and argue the broader economic fallout will likely be limited.

item.title: 'A generational win' for Dems as blue wave sweeps midterms
item.description: Democrats seized control of the US Congress on Tuesday, capturing the Senate and House of Representatives in a stunning, nationwide rejection of Donald Trump. France 24's Wassim Cornet says it is "impossible to overstate" the scale of the victory for the Democrats, with the party on course to win more seats in the House than they had when Barak Obama was elected in 2008.

item.title: Abdul El-Sayed set to become first Muslim senator after win in Michigan
item.description: Progressive favorite Abdul El-Sayed has defeated Republican Mike Rogers in a bitter campaign for Michigan’s open Senate seat, giving the Democratic Party’s left wing a breakthrough victory in one of the nation’s most important swing states. El-Sayed, the son of Egyptian immigrants, will become the nation’s first Muslim senator. France 24's Jessica Le Masurier has more.

item.title: Hakeem Jeffries is poised to become the first Black speaker of the House
item.description: As speaker, the New York Democrat would be second in the presidential line of succession, after the vice president. He has vowed to focus on affordability and holding the administration accountable.

item.title: 'Blue tsunami' in US midterms 'pummels GOP out of power'
item.description: PRESS REVIEW – Wednesday, November 4: US papers react to the results of the midterm elections, with Democrats retaking control of Congress and the headlines running from a "repudiation" of US President Donald Trump to a "blue tsunami". We also look at the historic firsts celebrated by the local press, the blame game already under way, and what the results mean for Trump's final two years in office.

item.title: Nevada Attorney General Aaron Ford beats GOP incumbent for governor
item.description: Democrat Aaron Ford defeated Republican Gov. Joe Lombardo. He's set to become Nevada's first Black governor.

item.title: Why the Democrats routed the Republicans in the US midterm elections
item.description: US voters on Tuesday handed the Democratic Party control over Congress in a biting rebuke to President Donald Trump and his MAGA movement. Polls suggest that rising anger about the cost-of-living crisis partly set off by the president’s decision to launch the US-Israeli war on Iran played a crucial part in the Democrats’ historic victory.

item.title: These candidates made history in the 2026 midterm elections
item.description: The midterms saw an expansion of representation among America's lawmakers, with several candidates celebrating groundbreaking wins.

item.title: Iran war, Epstein, impeachment? What will Democrats do with control of Congress?
item.description: Democrats have dominated the US midterm elections and are set to take both the House of Representatives and the Senate giving them a swathe of new powers. After the new Congress is sworn in on January 3, they will be able to block partisan legislation, and the US President's picks for roles like Supreme Court Justices - plus, they will have the authority to subpoena documents and witnesses. So what do the Democrats hope to do with their newfound powers? Eliza Herbert takes a look.

item.title: US midterms: Will Trump stick to his word and accept results?
item.description: Donald Trump struck a conciliatory note following sweeping victory for the in the midterm elections, telling The New York Times he was "absolutely willing" to accept the defeat. But the “crucial question” is whether Trump will stick to his word and abide by the results, given his history of questioning election outcomes, says France 24’s Philip Turle.

item.title: US midterms latest results: Mississippi Senate race 'neck and neck'
item.description: France 24's Dheepthika Laurent breaks down the numbers and takes a look at the latest results in the US midterms. Among the races yet to be called is the battle for the Senate in Mississippi, which remains neck and neck, she says.

item.title: Democrat Abdul El-Sayed to become first Muslim senator after winning Michigan race
item.description: Democrat Abdul El-Sayed has defeated Republican Mike Rogers in a bitter campaign for Michigan’s open Senate seat, making him the first Muslim elected to the upper chamber of Congress. During his campaign, El-Sayed had to contend with Islamophobic attacks from Republicans and his primary opponent endorsing Rogers.

item.title: WATCH: Keisha Lance Bottoms addresses supporters after projected win in Georgia gov. race
item.description: Democrat Keisha Lance Bottoms addressed supporters after ABC News projected her the winner of the Georgia governor's race, making her the first Black female governor in the history of the U.S.

item.title: What next for Iran war after Trump's midterms defeat?
item.description: ⁠Iranian parliament ​Speaker Mohammad Baqer ​Qalibaf said on Wednesday that Americans ​have rejected ‌the ⁠Iran war, and ‌the US government should ⁠not ignore public opinion by attacking ​his country ‌again, following a sweeping victory for the Democrats widely seen as a rebuke of the Trump administration. But in a conflict that has often proved highly unpredictable, it is too early to say what the election's impact will be, says France 24's correspondent in Iran Reza Sayed.

item.title: School children to be offered lessons on how to spot fraud
item.description: School children in England are to be offered lessons to help spot fraud and protect themselves from financial exploitation.

item.title: WATCH: Amy Acton addresses supporters after projected win in Ohio governor's race
item.description: Democrat Amy Acton addressed supporters after ABC News projected she will win the Ohio governor's race over Republican Vivek Ramaswamy.

item.title: 'The mood got better and better as the night went on': Dems celebrate midterms victory
item.description: Wassim Cornet, France 24's correspondent in Los Angeles, was at a Democratic watch party as midterms results rolled in overnight. He recounts how initial apprehension gave way to celebrations as it became increasingly clear the Democrats were on course for victory. "The mood got better and better as the night went on", he says.

item.title: US midterms: Trump 'has done everything to make life difficult for business owners'
item.description: As Democrats take control of Congress at the midterms, what impact did the global tariffs imposed by President Donald Trump have on the vote? Many small businesses in the United States say they are being stifled by the tariffs, with the consulting firm Epiq Global's October assessment saying small business bankruptcies increased 46 per cent from the previous year. France 24 Bogota team spoke with small business owners to understand how they are coping with these import taxes and what impact they are having on the economy.

item.title: Four oil tankers destroyed in Hormuz after hitting mines, Tehran says
item.description: Four oil tankers caught fire after hitting mines in the Strait of Hormuz, Tehran claimed Wednesday, a day after US President Donald Trump said the United States had launched strikes on Iran. Discussions to end the war between Washington and Tehran via mediators have continued with little sign of diplomatic breakthrough.

item.title: Democrat Abdul El-Sayed wins Michigan Senate race, will become first Muslim senator
item.description: 🇺🇸 Progressive favorite Abdul #El-Sayed has defeated Republican Mike #Rogers in a bitter campaign for #Michigan’s open Senate seat.​​

item.title: WATCH: Texas Gov. Greg Abbott addresses supporters after conceding governor's race
item.description: Republican Texas Gov. Greg Abbott addressed supporters after ABC News projected Democrat Gina Hinojosa will win the state's race for governor.

item.title: WATCH: Jon Ossoff addresses supporters after projected win in Georgia Senate race
item.description: Democrat Jon Ossoff addressed supporters after ABC News projected he will win reelection in the Georgia Senate race.

item.title: Midterms: What impact did redistricting in California and Texas have?
item.description: Last year, California voters approved a bill to temporarily redraw the state’s congressional map to make certain congressional districts more favourable to the Democrats – itself a response to a Republican-led redistricting push that began in Texas. France 24’s Wassim Cornet in Los Angeles takes a look at what impact these efforts may have had on the midterm results.

item.title: Blue wave 'turning into a tsunami' as Democrats take control of Congress
item.description: Democrats seized control of both the Senate and House at the US midterms on November 3, scoring sweeping victories in Republican strongholds for the first time in generations as tens of millions of voters delivered a scathing rebuke to President Donald Trump. Many analysts had predicted a "blue wave" would sweep the elections, but that is now "heading into tsunami territory", says France 24's international affairs editor Kethevane Gorjestani.

item.title: US midterms: Democrat James Talarico wins Senate race in deep-red Texas
item.description: 🇺🇸 Democrat James Talarico said Tuesday that "we defeated Goliath" after winning a US Senate seat over Texas attorney General Ken Paxton.

item.title: Talarico says 'power belongs to the people' as Democrats win big in Texas
item.description: Democrat James Talarico flipped a US Senate seat in Texas on Tuesday, defeating Republican Ken Paxton to pull off the first statewide victory in more than 30 years and sending a jolt through a longtime GOP stronghold that President Donald Trump carried by double digits just two years ago. In another political earthquake for the southern border state, Democrat Gina Hinojosa unseated incumbent Texas Governor Greg Abbott. France 24's correspondent in Texas Andres Espinal has the latest.

item.title: Democrat Abdul El-Sayed defeats Republican Mike Rogers in key Michigan Senate race
item.description: El-Sayed's campaign tested how an antiestablishment candidate on the left would fare in a perennial Midwest battleground. With the win, he'll become the first Muslim American to serve in the Senate.

item.title: Republicans tried to gerrymander their way out of big congressional losses. It didn't work
item.description: Among the sweeping victories by Democrats on Tuesday were wins in several congressional districts that Republicans had redrawn explicitly to boost their party ahead of the midterms.

item.title: WATCH: James Talarico addresses supporters after projected win in Texas Senate race
item.description: Democrat James Talarico addressed supporters after ABC News projected him the winner of the Texas Senate race, defeating Republican Ken Paxton.

item.title: Trump congratulates Democrats on midterms win, says Iran war played role
item.description: US President Donald Trump said rival Democrats had done "a good job" Tuesday after they gained control of Congress in the midterm elections. While Trump acknowledged that the Iran war may have played a part in the defeat of his Republican Party, he did not take personal responsability for the result that will upend the last two years of his presidency.

item.title: 2026 Midterms: Democrat Keisha Lance Bottoms makes history in Georgia
item.description: Democrat Keisha Lance Bottoms was elected governor of Georgia on Tuesday, making history as the first Black woman to be elected governor in the United States, defeating Republican businessman Rick Jackson and flipping the top job in a key swing state.

item.title: House Democratic Leader Hakeem Jeffries declares "America is back"
item.description: Jeffries, who addressed supporters after House control was called for Democrats , argued voters have sent Congress a message to end extremism and "corruption."

item.description: 24/7 coverage of breaking news and live events

item.title: Troy Jackson wins Maine Senate race over Susan Collins, in major coup for Democrats
item.description: The result is a crucial victory for Democrats in their push to retake the Senate majority, flipping a seat that Collins has held for nearly 30 years.

item.title: 'Expect the worst': What results mean for the world
item.description: Trump restrained or Trump rampant? That is the question for the world now as it looks on at his humiliation in the midterms.

item.title: Here's how some key demographic groups voted in the midterms
item.description: These charts show how various demographic groups voted in the midterm election. The data comes from a poll of tens of thousands of voters, conducted by the firm SSRS for a number of news outlets.

item.title: Former Arkansas governor says Democrats' gains are 'more significant than ever anticipated'
item.description: NPR's Scott Detrow speaks with former Arkansas Gov. Asa Hutchinson about Democratic victories in states typically considered Republican strongholds.

item.description: Democratic Gov. Josh Shapiro addressed supporters after ABC News projected he will win reelection in the Pennsylvania governor's race.

item.description: Wall Street markets have fallen as Democrats continue to gain ground across the country in the midterms.

item.description: Americans from Michigan to Maine, Texas to Kansas lined up to make their voices heard on Pres. Trump’s policies and which party will control Congress.

item.title: Spain's transport minister to resign after train crash killed 69 people
item.description: Spain's transport minister has said he will step down after two deadly train crashes in less than a year.

item.title: WATCH: Latino voters emerge as critical voting bloc in midterms
item.description: Héctor Sánchez Barba, president and CEO of Mi Familia Vota, discusses the diverse electorate emerging as a swing group in some key races.

item.title: Third teen arrested on suspicion of attempted murder over stabbing at Halloween party
item.description: A third boy has been arrested on suspicion of attempted murder after five teenagers were seriously injured when they were allegedly stabbed at a party on Halloween.

item.title: Andrew compelled to testify at businessman's fraud trial

item.description: ABC News’ Chief Washington Correspondent Jon Karl and Chief Business Correspondent Rebecca Jarvis break down why states in deep-red territory are in play and the state of the economy on Election Day.

item.title: Australia's social media ban challenged by Reddit and rights group in court
item.description: Australia's landmark social media ban for under-16s faces challenges in court over accusations that it amounts to censorship and creates privacy issues.

item.title: Bomb threats reported on multiple flights, including two from UK airports
item.description: At least seven flights, including two from the UK, have been affected by bomb threats, which caused unplanned landings and temporary airport closures.

item.title: WATCH: David Muir shares New Jersey students' determination in 100-Yard Food Drive Challenge
item.description: Students at Howell High School filled their football field with over a quarter million pounds of food for the nonprofit, Dermer Dreams. David Muir reports on the volunteers that delivered.

item.title: WATCH: Man complete 31,000-mile walk around the world after 28 years
item.description: A British adventurer who has been walking around the world for almost three decades returned to his childhood home Monday.

item.title: Spanish footballer dies after on-field collision
item.description: Tenerife football player Jesus de Miguel has died after suffering a cardiac arrest following an on-field collision in a match on Monday.

item.title: WATCH: 5 people at Chili's in North Carolina suffer burns after margarita mix-up
item.description: Three customers and two employees at a Chili's restaurant suffered chemical burns after an employee mistakenly used a cleaning powder instead of sugar to make the drinks, health officials say.

item.title: US carries out 'limited strikes' on Qeshm Island in Iran
item.description: The US military has carried out "limited strikes" on Qeshm Island in Iran - hours before the midterms are due to take place.

item.title: British troops will be allowed to fire at Russian forces if attacked during multinational mission
item.description: British troops will be allowed to fire back at Russian forces if attacked as part of a multinational mission to secure any future peace in Ukraine, Western officials have said.

item.description: ICE is facing new scrutiny over a video that allegedly shows an ICE agent pointing a gun in the face of a bystander in California.
